description: Defines the SystemTrustStore interface and related functions for managing platform-specific trust stores in Chromium's network security code.

classes.name: SystemTrustStore
classes.description: Interface for platform-specific trust store management, including trust store retrieval, system trust usage, and root certificate verification.

methods.name: GetTrustStore
methods.description: Returns an aggregate TrustStore for path building, combining system and manually added trust anchors.

methods.name: UsesSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Indicates whether the implementation uses the system's trust store.

methods.name: IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is a known root from the system trust store.

methods.name: chrome_root_store_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Chrome Root Store, if supported.
